First-time cruisers often either overpack or forget the small things that make a week at sea more comfortable, so a little planning helps.

## Documents first

Passports, boarding passes, and any required visas should go in a single folder you can access quickly at embarkation, since lines move faster when paperwork is ready.

## Clothing for onboard life

Most cruise lines have relaxed daytime dress codes but still expect smart-casual attire for dinner, so pack at least one or two outfits that go beyond shorts and t-shirts.

## Small essentials people forget

A power strip, motion sickness remedies, and a reusable water bottle are consistently the items past cruisers say they wish they'd packed.

Shore excursions often involve more walking than people expect, so comfortable, broken-in shoes matter more on a cruise than almost any other single packing decision.
